query: The Night Hush The overdue book will only be on the shelves the night hush sends it to. The head librarian lends you the old lamp. "Walk the hush," she says, "and listen to which shelf goes quiet last." Walk the hush and listen Three laps, and on the third, the shelves on the north side go quiet a heartbeat after the rest. You mark it on your map. The lamp seems pleased with you. Every shelf goes quiet at once, which is either very helpful or a joke at your expense. You walk until midnight and mark nothing. Ask the head librarian outright "If I told you," she says, "you wouldn't have found it." She gives you extra shelving for asking.
